test_cases.name: Unsanitized dangerouslySetInnerHTML Rendering
test_cases.rationale: Directly injecting raw HTML into dangerouslySetInnerHTML without DOMPurify enables stored/DOM XSS.

test_cases.name: Dynamic Anchor Href Allowing Javascript Pseudo-Protocol
test_cases.rationale: Unvalidated target URL in anchor tag allows javascript: execution and reverse tabnabbing.

test_cases.name: Hardcoded Private Stripe Secret Key in Client Code
test_cases.rationale: Bundling backend private API secret into frontend static assets leaks full merchant privileges.

test_cases.name: Auth Token Exposed in URL Query Parameters
test_cases.rationale: Appending access token to URL leaks credentials through Referer headers and browser history.

test_cases.name: Client-Side Multi-Tenant Data Filtering
test_cases.rationale: Fetching all tenant data and filtering client-side allows unauthorized users to inspect all records.

test_cases.name: Cookie Mutation Request Missing CSRF Protection
test_cases.rationale: State-changing POST request with ambient cookies lacks anti-CSRF token headers.

test_cases.name: PostMessage Listener Missing Origin Verification
test_cases.rationale: Handling window message events without origin checks allows malicious iframe injection.

test_cases.name: Dynamic Script Injection from Untrusted URL
test_cases.rationale: Dynamically inserting script element from untrusted source enables remote code execution.

test_cases.name: Plaintext Payment Card Details in LocalStorage
test_cases.rationale: Persisting payment card and CVV details in localStorage violates PCI-DSS and exposes PII.

test_cases.name: Debug Privilege Escalation Backdoor on Window
test_cases.rationale: Exposing global window debug backdoor allows client-side privilege tampering in production.

test_cases.name: Compliant Frontend Security Reference Implementation
test_cases.rationale: Clean implementation using DOMPurify, URL protocol validation, and strict postMessage origin checks.
